    5   def statStageAtMax?(stat)

    9   def pbCanRaiseStatStage?(stat, user = nil, move = nil, showFailMsg = false, ignoreContrary = false)
   10     return false if fainted?
   11     # Contrary
   12     if hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY) && !ignoreContrary && !@battle.moldBreaker
   13       return pbCanLowerStatStage?(stat, user, move, showFailMsg, true)
   14     end
   15     # Check the stat stage
   16     if statStageAtMax?(stat)
   17       if showFailMsg
   18         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} won't go any higher!",
   19                                 pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(stat).name))
   20       end
   21       return false
   22     end
   23     return true
   24   end

   26   def pbRaiseStatStageBasic(stat, increment, ignoreContrary = false)
   27     if !@battle.moldBreaker
   28       # Contrary
   29       if hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY) && !ignoreContrary
   30         return pbLowerStatStageBasic(stat, increment, true)
   31       end
   32       # Simple
   33       increment *= 2 if hasActiveAbility?(:SIMPLE)
   34     end
   35     # Change the stat stage
   36     increment = [increment, STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM - @stages[stat]].min
   37     if increment > 0
   38       stat_name = GameData::Stat.get(stat).name
   39       new = @stages[stat] + increment
   40       PBDebug.log("[Stat change] #{pbThis}'s #{stat_name} changed by +#{increment} (#{@stages[stat]} -> #{new})")
   41       @stages[stat] += increment
   42       @statsRaisedThisRound = true
   43     end
   44     return increment
   45   end

   47   def pbRaiseStatStage(stat, increment, user, showAnim = true, ignoreContrary = false)
   48     # Contrary
   49     if hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY) && !ignoreContrary && !@battle.moldBreaker
   50       return pbLowerStatStage(stat, increment, user, showAnim, true)
   51     end
   52     # Perform the stat stage change
   53     increment = pbRaiseStatStageBasic(stat, increment, ignoreContrary)
   54     return false if increment <= 0
   55     # Stat up animation and message
   56     @battle.pbCommonAnimation("StatUp", self) if showAnim
   57     arrStatTexts = [
   58       _INTL("{1}'s {2} rose!", pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(stat).name),
   59       _INTL("{1}'s {2} rose sharply!", pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(stat).name),
   60       _INTL("{1}'s {2} rose drastically!", pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(stat).name)
   61     ]
   62     @battle.pbDisplay(arrStatTexts[[increment - 1, 2].min])
   63     # Trigger abilities upon stat gain
   64     if abilityActive?
   65       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerOnStatGain(self.ability, self, stat, user)
   66     end
   67     return true
   68   end

  101   def pbRaiseStatStageByAbility(stat, increment, user, splashAnim = true)
  102     return false if fainted?
  103     ret = false
  104     @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(user) if splashAnim
  105     if pbCanRaiseStatStage?(stat, user, nil, Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
  106       if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  107         ret = pbRaiseStatStage(stat, increment, user)
  108       else
  109         ret = pbRaiseStatStageByCause(stat, increment, user, user.abilityName)
  110       end
  111     end
  112     @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(user) if splashAnim
  113     return ret
  114   end

  123   def pbCanLowerStatStage?(stat, user = nil, move = nil, showFailMsg = false,
  124                            ignoreContrary = false, ignoreMirrorArmor = false)
  125     return false if fainted?
  126     if !@battle.moldBreaker
  127       # Contrary
  128       if hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY) && !ignoreContrary
  129         return pbCanRaiseStatStage?(stat, user, move, showFailMsg, true)
  130       end
  131       # Mirror Armor
  132       if hasActiveAbility?(:MIRRORARMOR) && !ignoreMirrorArmor &&
  133          user && user.index != @index && !statStageAtMin?(stat)
  134         return true
  135       end
  136     end
  137     if !user || user.index != @index   # Not self-inflicted
  138       if @effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0 &&
  139          (ignoreMirrorArmor || !(move && move.ignoresSubstitute?(user)))
  140         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is protected by its substitute!", pbThis)) if showFailMsg
  141         return false
  142       end
  143       if pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Mist] > 0 &&
  144          !(user && user.hasActiveAbility?(:INFILTRATOR))
  145         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is protected by Mist!", pbThis)) if showFailMsg
  146         return false
  147       end
  148       if abilityActive?
  149         return false if !@battle.moldBreaker && Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatLossImmunity(
  150           self.ability, self, stat, @battle, showFailMsg
  151         )
  152         return false if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatLossImmunityNonIgnorable(
  153           self.ability, self, stat, @battle, showFailMsg
  154         )
  155       end
  156       if !@battle.moldBreaker
  157         allAllies.each do |b|
  158           next if !b.abilityActive?
  159           return false if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerStatLossImmunityFromAlly(
  160             b.ability, b, self, stat, @battle, showFailMsg
  161           )
  162         end
  163       end
  164     end
  165     # Check the stat stage
  166     if statStageAtMin?(stat)
  167       if showFailMsg
  168         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} won't go any lower!",
  169                                 pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(stat).name))
  170       end
  171       return false
  172     end
  173     return true
  174   end

  176   def pbLowerStatStageBasic(stat, increment, ignoreContrary = false)

  178       # Contrary
  179       if hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY) && !ignoreContrary
  180         return pbRaiseStatStageBasic(stat, increment, true)
  181       end
  182       # Simple
  183       increment *= 2 if hasActiveAbility?(:SIMPLE)
  184     end

  186     increment = [increment, STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM + @stages[stat]].min
  187     if increment > 0
  188       stat_name = GameData::Stat.get(stat).name
  189       new = @stages[stat] - increment
  190       PBDebug.log("[Stat change] #{pbThis}'s #{stat_name} changed by -#{increment} (#{@stages[stat]} -> #{new})")
  191       @stages[stat] -= increment
  192       @statsLoweredThisRound = true
  193       @statsDropped = true
  194     end
  195     return increment
